title: Steve Lewis
summary: Hug does not remember Steve Lewis, though he may have heard him.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I don't remember knowing Steve. He must have been just a little bit before my time, I believe. Well, Harry, Sujohn remembers him well from Victor's.

Well, Harry should, because I'm the same age as Harry. And I should remember Steve, too. Maybe I heard him playing. Like I say, you know, when you're a young kid coming up, you get around, and in those days, it was just a little bit different. I mean, you'd hear a guy and you wouldn't even know who he was. I mean, you'd just know, well, he played good. And probably I did hear Steve playing, because I heard quite a number of fine guys playing piano, and never did get to know who they really was.
